scope: Cross-model fair benchmark only; this contract does not describe RAPLKT model innovations.

raw_preprocessing.id_mapping: Map uid, question, and KC strings to deterministic raw 0-based integer IDs in first-occurrence order after filtering and multi-KC expansion; persist keyid2idx.json.
raw_preprocessing.multi_kc_expansion: A KC string joined with '_' is expanded into consecutive positions. The first position has is_repeat=0 and each additional KC has is_repeat=1. Question, response, timestamp, and use-time fields are repeated across the block.
raw_preprocessing.item_boundary_safe_segmentation: train_valid_sequences.csv and test_sequences.csv are packed to maxlen without splitting an is_repeat item block. A block longer than maxlen is an error. A final segment shorter than min_seq_len is dropped.

student_split.rounding: test_count=floor(number_of_students*0.2); shuffled prefix is train+valid and suffix is test

folds.assignment: Reshuffle train+valid student rows with random_state=1024, divide contiguous rows into folds 0..4, and distribute the remainder one student at a time to the earliest folds.
folds.training_definition: For requested fold f, train on folds {0,1,2,3,4} minus {f} and validate only on fold f.

files.train_valid_sequences.csv: Item-boundary-safe, non-overlapping, maxlen-padded train/validation sequences with fold, selectmasks, and is_repeat.
files.test.csv: Complete expanded-position held-out student histories before sequence segmentation; fold=-1; includes globally unique expanded-position cidxs.
files.test_sequences.csv: Item-boundary-safe, non-overlapping Test sequences; tails shorter than min_seq_len are dropped.
files.test_window_sequences.csv: Expanded-position Window Test. For histories longer than maxlen, the first maxlen window selects all eligible positions and each later one-position slide selects only its final position. This is not an item-level window.
files.keyid2idx.json: Raw string-to-0-based-ID mappings for uid/questions/concepts plus max_concepts.

loader_protocol.q2cs_builder_rule: Build raw question->sorted unique KC sets from complete test.csv metadata, truncate only after sorting to dataset max_concepts, and never read a response label.
loader_protocol.repeat_rule: Collapse one rep=0 plus following rep=1 positions into one item. If q2cs already supplies the complete set, visible repeats must not append duplicate KCs.
loader_protocol.orphan_repeat_rule: A leading is_repeat=1 block caused by a window boundary is history only and must have no evaluation target.
loader_protocol.raw_ids: Manifest, q2cs, and contract IDs are raw 0-based IDs.

internal_ids.AKT: Use raw IDs directly and -1 for preprocessing padding.
internal_ids.RAPLKT: Add 1 internally so 0 is padding; subtract 1 when writing manifests.

loader_protocol.target_selection: Predictions use positions 0..S-2 to predict positions 1..S-1. smasks are the shifted selectmasks intersected with valid adjacent positions; collapsed rep=1 positions and orphan repeats are not targets.
loader_protocol.one_probability_per_item: Each eligible collapsed item target contributes exactly one scalar probability; no KC-level probability may be counted as a separate example.
loader_protocol.candidate_k_rule: K is the number of true entries in the full shifted candidate-KC mask for that item, not the visible KC count and not the model's chosen responsibility support.

evaluation.aggregation: Concatenate all eligible item targets globally, then compute metrics once; do not average per student, sequence, window, item, or KC.
evaluation.accuracy: Global item-level accuracy with predicted label 1 iff probability >= 0.5.

checkpoint_selection.strict_best: Save whenever current validation AUC is strictly greater than the true best validation AUC, even if the increase is smaller than early_stop_min_delta.
checkpoint_selection.patience: early_stop_min_delta affects only the independent patience reference and never suppresses a true-best checkpoint.
checkpoint_selection.forbidden: Test and Window Test labels or metrics must not affect checkpointing, early stopping, hyperparameter selection, or model selection.

field_rules.target_cidx: Required non-negative globally unique expanded-position identity of the rep=0 target; shft_cidxs must exist and placeholder -1 is forbidden.
field_rules.kc_ids: Comma-separated raw 0-based unique KC IDs; writer output is sorted.
field_rules.k_count: Must equal the number of unique IDs in kc_ids.
field_rules.prediction: One scalar item-correctness probability. It is model-specific and excluded from target-identity equality.

rules: Both manifests must contain the same number of rows.
target_cidx must be integer, non-negative, and unique within each manifest.
Canonical-sort both manifests by target_cidx before comparison.
kc_ids must be comma-separated integers with no duplicates; compare KC sets in sorted canonical order.
k_count must equal the unique KC count.
After canonicalization, target_cidx, question_id, response, kc_ids, and k_count must match exactly row by row.

applies_to: other KT models without native multi-KC input
external_model_adapter.minimum_rule: Preserve the complete candidate KC set for every item and aggregate it into one item representation using a response-free symmetric operation.
allowed_examples: permutation-invariant attention whose query and weights do not use the current response
forbidden: using the current response or label to construct the item input
changing target identities or data splits

preprocessing_rules: Read the tab-separated source with UTF-8 and low_memory=False.
Sanitize Problem Name and Step Name with replace_text and define question as '<Problem Name>----<Step Name>'.
Drop rows missing Anon Student Id, derived Questions, KC(Default), First Transaction Time, or Correct First Attempt.
Keep only Correct First Attempt in {0,1}.
Sanitize KC(Default); interpret '~~' as the multi-KC delimiter and convert it to '_' before shared expansion.
Group students with sort=False and order each student's interactions by converted First Transaction Time, then original source-row index.

resolved_protocol.multi_kc: Expand every item to rep=0 followed by zero or more rep=1 positions; collapse back to one item with the complete unique KC set.
resolved_protocol.window: Expanded-position maxlen=200 window; q2cs comes only from test.csv metadata and response is forbidden.
resolved_protocol.targets_and_metrics: Shift by one, select with smasks, emit one probability per eligible item, then compute global item-level AUC/ACC and K1/K2/K3+/Multi groups from the complete KC set.
resolved_protocol.loader_order: train shuffled; validation, Test, and Window Test sequential.
resolved_protocol.checkpoint: Strict best validation AUC; early_stop_min_delta only controls patience; Test and Window Test are never selection inputs.

preprocessing_rules: Read the UTF-8 CSV with low_memory=False.
Drop rows missing studentId, problemId, correct, skill, or startTime and keep only correct in {0,1}.
For each problemId, build the deterministic first-appearance-order union of sanitized real skill values across the filtered data.
Exclude skill equal to 'noskill' case-insensitively from the union. Remove every interaction of a problemId whose union has no real KC.
Attach the same complete underscore-joined union KC set to every remaining interaction of that problemId.
Convert timeTaken to rounded milliseconds and startTime to integer milliseconds.
Group students with sort=False and order each student's interactions by startTime, then original source-row index.

resolved_protocol.multi_kc: Use problemId's complete real-KC union, expand to rep=0 followed by rep=1 positions, and collapse back to one item with the complete unique set.
resolved_protocol.window: Expanded-position maxlen=200 window; q2cs comes only from test.csv metadata and response is forbidden.
resolved_protocol.targets_and_metrics: Shift by one, select with smasks, emit one probability per eligible item, then compute global item-level AUC/ACC and K1/K2/K3+/Multi groups from the complete KC set.
resolved_protocol.loader_order: train shuffled; validation, Test, and Window Test sequential.
resolved_protocol.checkpoint: Strict best validation AUC; early_stop_min_delta only controls patience; Test and Window Test are never selection inputs.
